units.source_text: 请求千重子的那个年轻人手戴镣铐，不知是什么罪犯。

en.t: The young man who had asked Chieko for help was wearing handcuffs, and she did not know what kind of criminal he was.

units.source_text: 他身旁的另一个男人可能是个刑警。

en.t: The other man beside him was probably a detective.

units.source_text: 大概是要翻过这深山老林，把犯人押送到什么地方去吧。

en.t: They were probably taking the prisoner across these deep mountains and old forests to some place or other.
